answer: 这个结论不对。RoG 的证据明确指出 MetaQA-3hop 基于 Wiki-Movies KGs，并为 MetaQA-3hop 构造 Wiki-Movies 子图 [E1, E3, E6]；Freebase 在 RoG 中对应 WebQSP 与 CWQ，是这两者的背景知识图 [E6, E9]。训练样本方面，RoG 用 WebQSP 和 CWQ 的训练划分构造指令微调数据 [E6]；对 MetaQA-3hop 则从训练划分选 1000 个样本，并比较从零训练与从 Freebase 迁移两种策略 [E1, E3]。KG-GPT 的证据只说 MetaQA 是电影领域、含 1/2/3-hop 的 KGQA 数据集 [E2, E4]，并未在该证据中把它标为 Freebase 测试 KG [E2, E4, E5]。因此，“Freebase 是二者的共同 MetaQA 测试 KG”缺乏依据，并与 RoG 的 Wiki-Movies 描述矛盾。

IMPLEMENTATION SETTINGS
For RoG, we use LLaMA2-Chat-7B (Touvron et al., 2023) as the LLM backbone, which is instruc-
tion finetuned on the training split of WebQSP and CWQ as well as Freebase for 3 epochs. The
batch size is set to 4 and the learning rate is set to 2e-5. We use the cosine learning rate scheduler
policy with the warmup ratio set to 0.03. The training is conducted on 2 A100-80G GPUs for 38
hours. During inference, we first adopt the LLM to generate top-K relation paths with the highest
probability as the plans. Then, we adopt the Algorithm 1 to retrieve reasoning paths, which are fed
into the LLM to reason the final answers.
For LLM beelines, we use zero-shot prompting to conduct KGQA, which directly asks LLMs to
answer the question. For other baselines, we directly copy their results reported in UniKGQA (Jiang
et al., 2022) and DECAF (Yu et al., 2022a) for comparisons.
For combining the planning module of RoG with different LLMs, we use the planning module to
generate plans (relation paths), which are executed on KGs to retrieve the reasoning paths. The
retrieved paths are fed into different LLMs during inference by utilizing the reasoning prompts
template shown in Appendix A.10.

evidence.quote:
Conclusion
We suggest KG-GPT, a versatile framework that
utilizes LLMs for tasks that use KGs. KG-GPT is
divided into three stages: Sentence Segmentation,
Graph Retrieval, and Inference, each designed for
breaking down sentences, sourcing related graph
elements, and reaching reasoned outcomes, respec-
tively. We assess KG-GPT’s efficacy using KG-
based fact verification and KGQA metrics, and
the model demonstrates consistent, impressive re-
sults, even surpassing a number of fully-supervised
models. Consequently, our research signifies a sub-
stantial advancement in combining structured and
unstructured data management in the LLMs’ con-
text.

raw: {"premise_check":[{"premise":"KG-GPT 与 RoG 都涉及 MetaQA","supported":true,"evidence_eids":["E2","E4","E5","E1","E3","E6"],"note":"MetaQA 在 KG-GPT 与 RoG 证据中均出现，作为评估/迁移数据集。"},{"premise":"Freebase 是 KG-GPT 与 RoG 共同的 MetaQA 测试 KG","supported":false,"evidence_eids":["E1","E3","E6","E9","E2","E4","E5"],"note":"RoG 证据明确说 MetaQA-3hop 基于 Wiki-Movies KGs，Freebase 是 WebQSP/CWQ 的 KG；KG-GPT 证据只说使用 MetaQA，未在该证据中说明是 Freebase 或 Wiki-Movies。"},{"premise":"RoG 的训练样本包括 WebQSP/CWQ 训练集和抽取子图，并在 MetaQA-3hop 上使用 1000 训练样本做迁移/从头训练","supported":true,"evidence_eids":["E6","E7","E1","E3"],"note":"RoG 用 WebQSP/CWQ 训练集构造指令数据；MetaQA-3hop 从训练集选 1000 样本，并有从头训练与从 Freebase 迁移两种策略；表 9 给出 MetaQA-3hop #Train=1,000。"},{"premise":"Wiki-Movies 在 RoG 中承担 MetaQA-3hop 的 KG 角色","supported":true,"evidence_eids":["E1","E3","E6"],"note":"原文说 MetaQA-3hop 基于 Wiki-Movies KGs，并为 MetaQA-3hop 构造 Wiki-Movies 子图。"},{"premise":"KG-GPT 在 MetaQA 上使用 Freebase 测试 KG","supported":false,"evidence_eids":["E2","E4","E5"],"note":"KG-GPT 证据描述 MetaQA 是电影领域 KG-based QA 数据集，但未说明其测试 KG 为 Freebase。"}],"answer":"这个结论不对。RoG 的证据明确指出 MetaQA-3hop 基于 Wiki-Movies KGs，并为 MetaQA-3hop 构造 Wiki-Movies 子图 [E1, E3, E6]；Freebase 在 RoG 中对应 WebQSP 与 CWQ，是这两者的背景知识图 [E6, E9]。训练样本方面，RoG 用 WebQSP 和 CWQ 的训练划分构造指令微调数据 [E6]；对 MetaQA-3hop 则从训练划分选 1000 个样本，并比较从零训练与从 Freebase 迁移两种策略 [E1, E3]。KG-GPT 的证据只说 MetaQA 是电影领域、含 1/2/3-hop 的 KGQA 数据集 [E2, E4]，并未在该证据中把它标为 Freebase 测试 KG [E2, E4, E5]。因此，“Freebase 是二者的共同 MetaQA 测试 KG”缺乏依据，并与 RoG 的 Wiki-Movies 描述矛盾。","citations":[{"eid":"E1","quote_id":"q1"},{"eid":"E3","quote_id":"q2"},{"eid":"E6","quote_id":"q1"},{"eid":"E9","quote_id":"q1"},{"eid":"E2","quote_id":"q2"},{"eid":"E4","quote_id":"q1"},{"eid":"E5","quote_id":"q1"}],"status":"refused"}
